tickets.text: Add (wyckoff): at the top of a run, reaccumulation and distribution look alike until the break holds outside the range (C5, C16); D close_vs_swing_high_pct -2.73 is still under the Creek, so it stays a WATCH until a break holds.

The trigger h1_close_above:pivot_high buys the break near the high at D close_vs_swing_high_pct -0.48; my method's entry is the back-up to the broken Creek, the test (C7). I would join on in_zone:structure_shift_ref on H1, a pull back into the broken Creek level, not on the break itself.

Add to would_change (wyckoff): the danger point is structural, not a percentage line - a daily close below base_low_20d (C17). The entry still waits for a sign-of-strength bar out of the trading zone (C12).

The trigger close_above:pivot_high buys a trend that has already left value; my method does not chase and joins on the test of value (C3, C15). I would join on reclaim:vwap_14d on H1: a dip under the 14-day VWAP and a 1-hour close back above it.

The trigger close_above:pivot_high buys a fresh break at D close_vs_swing_high_pct -2.58; my method's entry is the test of the broken Creek after it, not the break itself (C7). I would join on reclaim:structure_shift_ref on H1: a dip under the broken Creek and a 1-hour close back above it.
